results.title: Microsoft President Backs Deployment of AI Safety Evaluators
results.description: Microsoft Corp. President Brad Smith said the company backs the use of independent evaluators for artificial intelligence.

results.title: Congested Vijay Nagar stretch of NH-9 set to get overbridge to check jaywalking
results.description: NHAI to build Rs 13 crore foot overbridge with lifts on NH-9 at Vijay Nagar, Ghaziabad, linking Krishan Babu Nagar to curb jaywalking; due in 1 year.
